title: Teen who died in hospital after spending night in jail cells identified
subtitle: The B.C. Coroners Service has identified a teenager who died after being transported to hospital from Port Alberni RCMP cells last week.
article: The B.C. Coroners Service has identified a teenager who died after being transported to hospital from Port Alberni RCMP cells last week.
Jocelyn Nynah Marsha George, 18, a resident of Port Alberni, was taken into custody by the Port Alberni RCMP on last Thursday. She was kept in a Port Alberni jail cell overnight.

George was found Friday morning in need of medical attention, the coroners service said. She was first transported by B.C. Ambulance Service to West Coast General Hospital in Port Alberni, then flown to Royal Jubilee Hospital in Victoria, where she died that night.

The coroners service and the Independent Investigations Office are investigating George's death. The IIO investigates police-related incidents of death or serious harm to determine whether an offence was committed.
George's family has been notified of her death.
